welcome-wms.title: Welcome to Warehouse Management System (WMS)
welcome-wms.description: WMS (Warehouse Management System) is an intelligent solution designed to optimize warehouse operations. It enhances logistics efficiency and accuracy through automated inventory management, real-time order processing, and intelligent storage layout. The system supports seamless integration with ERP, TMS, etc., enabling full supply chain collaboration to help enterprises reduce operational costs and improve customer satisfaction.
welcome-wms.download-description: Manage warehouse anytime, anywhere with more efficient mobile operations
welcome-wms.download-description-more: Break free from fixed workstations! The mobile APP allows real-time synchronization of warehouse dynamics. Complete inbound, outbound, transfer, and counting operations by scanning codes anywhere. Improve on-site efficiency for smarter, more flexible warehouse management!

tooltips.dn: DN Inventory: Outbound order waiting for picking. Generated DN not yet picked. Excluded from current inventory calculation.

methods.title: Handling methods
methods.intro: Choose how waybills, pickups and tracking are handled for this carrier. The whole flow works without an API contract; the online (API) options need the online integration above to be on and to support them.

pickup.manual: Book by phone / website, record in WMS

waybill.api: WMS creates the waybill through the integration and gets the label and tracking number. If the carrier's system is down you can still enter a number by hand.
waybill.file: Export a CSV in the carrier software's format, print the labels there, then import the tracking numbers back. No API contract needed.
waybill.manual: Print the label on the carrier's website or software, then enter or scan the tracking number in WMS.

pickup.api: Book the courier online from the shipping flow or the Pickups page.
pickup.manual: Book by phone or on the carrier's website, then record the date, time and confirmation number in WMS.
pickup.scheduled: The carrier comes on fixed days; no booking is needed for each shipment.
pickup.dropoff: You take the parcels to the carrier's location.
pickup.none: WMS doesn't arrange pickups for this carrier.

tracking.api: WMS checks tracking regularly: shipping is completed when the carrier picks up, and delivery is confirmed when the carrier delivers.
tracking.link: Only a link to the carrier's public tracking page is shown; delivery is confirmed by hand (or by the auto-sign rule).
tracking.none: No tracking. Delivery is confirmed by hand (or by the auto-sign rule).

methods.api-unavailable: Online (API) needs the online integration to be on and to support it.
methods.tracking-url-hint: Put {placeholder} where the tracking number goes. Leave blank to use the integration's built-in page.
methods.auto-sign-help: When set, a shipment that isn't tracked through the API is signed automatically N days after handover (source: Rule). Delivery can always be confirmed by hand. Leave blank to turn it off.

unresolved.title: Shipment status unclear
unresolved.description: The shipment may already exist at {carrier}. Check {portal} first, then continue here.
unresolved.cancel-unknown-description: {carrier} didn't say whether it was cancelled. Retry the cancellation, or check {portal} and unlock. It can't ship until then.
unresolved.in-progress: Someone is creating the shipment for this order. This page refreshes on its own.
unresolved.cancelling: The shipment is being cancelled. This page refreshes on its own.
unresolved.stalled: No result after a long wait. Click Refresh; if it stays like this, contact your administrator.
unresolved.step1-no-tracking: Look the shipment up in {portal} by recipient and ship date
unresolved.step2: If it's there, cancel it there
unresolved.step3: Come back, click "Resolved, unlock" and create the shipment again
unresolved.dismiss-confirm: Confirm that {portal} has no such shipment, or that it's cancelled. After unlocking you can create it again; if it does still exist, it will be created and charged twice.

unresolved.dismissed: Unlocked, you can create the shipment again

reasons.compensation_failed: saving failed after it was created, and the automatic cancel failed
reasons.save_unconfirmed: created, but not sure it was saved

summary.waybill-api: Not created yet; create it online with {carrier}

pickup.schedule-unset: Regular pickup (days and times not set)
pickup.schedule-hint: {carrier} collects on these days; no booking is needed for each shipment.
pickup.after-waybill: Available once the waybill is ready
pickup.record-intro: Book the pickup with {carrier} by phone or on its website, then record the date, time and confirmation number here. WMS does not contact the carrier.
pickup.confirmation-code-hint: Optional: the number the carrier gave you
pickup.page-intro-manual: Pickups with {carrier} are booked by phone or on its website. Tick the shipments the courier will take, then record the agreed date and time.

handover.time-invalid: Enter a valid date and time
handover.time-future: The time can't be later than now

handover.by-carrier: Completed automatically when the carrier picked up

delivered.manual-hint: You can always confirm delivery by hand with the actual time.

delivered.auto-by-tracking: Signed automatically when the carrier reports delivery
delivered.by-rule: Signed automatically by rule ({days} days after handover)
delivered.by-carrier: Signed when the carrier reported delivery
delivered.time-before-handover: The delivery time can't be earlier than the handover ({time})

problems.AUTO_SIGN_BLOCKED: The carrier delivered, but delivery could not be confirmed automatically: {message}
